name: Brno University of Technology ECG Quality Database (BUT QDB)
description: The BUT ECG Quality Database (BUT QDB) is an annotated electrocardiographic benchmark curated by Brno University of Technology in the Czech Republic. It consists of 180 two-minute single-lead ECG recordings selected from 15 subjects recorded over 24 hours under active, free-living ambulatory conditions using wearable Bittium Faros 180 monitors. Three independent medical and engineering experts audited each recording, providing continuous beat-by-beat quality segmentations into three classes: optimal quality, suboptimal quality, and uninterpretable/artifact. The benchmark enables training and objective evaluation of automated ECG signal quality assessment (SQA) and noise rejection algorithms.
